name: C2Scene_UnpackBg3MapPack
notes: Fix verified: unpacked ScriptPacks 2 (+$0286) and 6 (+$027E) hold op $34 $7B20, $16 bytes after op $34 $7AFC; no ROM copy of 34 20 7B. Exit A/B, X, Y and DP/DB checked.

name: C3_BootModule
notes: Fix verified: X = C3_BootNmi or $00D3 by bit 7, A=$30C3. $FE:0003 = $1313/$C3 (bank unread), OutLen $857F, module $7E:3003 AND #$1F / JSR ($3043,X). Callers' M/X/DB ok.

name: WinFx_BuildCircle
notes: Odd-table text false: HalfPtr=RowPtr>>1 then ASL makes every Xc+-y write even, i.e. 1 byte low for an odd table (straddles 2 rows; fill hits it). Say even tables only. Lower-fill fix ok.

name: WinFx_StepWipe
notes: Fill (STA.l+MVN $DF), buffers by frame parity, runs 3-34/4-35, steps 8-11/9-12, clamps, B=$03 after TDC, stop at $20 checked. nit: WMADDL/H stores are .w with the caller's DB too.

name: C3_RandomByte
notes: Fix verified: CMP SLHV carry into ADC OPHCT, final SBC OPVCT listed. nit: OPHCT is read once per call, so 'low byte' assumes STAT78 was read since (Field_EndOfFrame does it per frame).

name: C3_ScaleBitmap
notes: Fix verified: clear Dest..old end (C=0) / old end+1 (C=1), diff 1 with C=0 none. $1F=4 at $7E:8299/$897D; MVN $1400/$140E->$1F 14 bytes; $502A=4, $50B6=3; DB=$7F at all 3 sites.

name: C3_BootIrq
notes: Fix verified: no store to $0500-$0507 in the unpacked module (kernel C3_ModuleFrame writes only the NMI one); NMITIMEN=$A1 at $7E:3017; module never writes VTIMEL. RTI/A state ok.

name: Decomp_ToWram
notes: Fix verified (any Dest; $00 bank byte -> $7E). Format vs all 4 loops; lengths/masks; $1313 = 26393 bytes -> $857F; C2 packs $13-$3000, 1-2 segments, exceptions as stated.

name: C3_RunScript
notes: Fix verified: $7E:37F3 = LDX #0/JSR ($00F0,X)/RTL. Opcode table, var/loop ops, dead $0BEF-$0C18, Ret=counter 7, DP $0A00/$0B00 + PHK/PLB sites, $C3:185C literal checked.

name: C3_SprListSmall
notes: Fix verified: DB must map I/O; $7E:3A78 has DB=$00 (PEA $007E at $7E:39F9, PLB, PLB at $3A72). List format, base adds, high-table shift, Exit X/Y checked.

name: C3_SprListLarge
notes: Fix verified: DB maps I/O. X+SprBaseX, BMI vs $100, $9801, ASL/ROR/SEC/ROR high bits checked. nit: signed CMP also sends X $8000-$80FF off screen.

name: BankC3_StaffText
notes: Bytes match the ROM ($0A first, $0A line ends, JONNY); no $36 $0E in the kernel or the unpacked module; xref finds no reference.

name: WinFx_BuildQuad
notes: Fix verified: CMP/BCC keeps the last minimum on ties. Chain, up-edge switch, fills (row 0, bottom..$FF, 1..top), odd count, A=$0003 checked. nit: edges/row 0 use the whole bank byte.

name: WinFx_QuadEdge
notes: Fix verified: flat edge X0 first iff bit 7 of X0-X1; larger first when X1-X0>=$81 or X0-X1>=$80. Swap, DDA starts (dx-dy, dy-|dx|-1), carries, DB, QuadExit checked.

name: BankC3_EndMarker
notes: ROM holds 'CODE END C3' at $10C0-$10CA after the RTL at $C3:10BF (QuadExit's); $00 fill from $10CB to $11FF checked.
